parsed.post: KEPT DEPTH 6->8: 1.0147 -> 0.9868. Increasing depth to 8 significantly improved performance. The model seems to handle the capacity increase well within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing DEPTH=10 at the same settings to see if capacity gains continue.
